rows.Product: Ready-to-eat meat and poultry products (about 1,584,361 lb, more than 100 items of various weights), produced approx. 31 Mar – 7 Oct 2026, bearing EST. M/P 7839, EST. P 20935A or EST. M 9520
rows.Reason: Class I recall: products may have experienced temperature abuse during storage in a warehouse cooler that had temperature deviations; found after a retail complaint about warm product at delivery on 1 Oct 2026. No confirmed illnesses. Shipped to retail, wholesale club and foodservice locations nationwide in the US and to Hong Kong.
rows.Notes: [week-42 finalization 2026-10-18] Operator ruling 2026-10-18: temperature abuse of ready-to-eat product is in scope (operator sent the FSIS notice URL). SOURCES: https://www.fsis.usda.gov/recalls-alerts/kayem-foods-inc--recalls-meat-and-poultry-products-due-possible-temperature-abuse (FSIS's own notice, the published URL; fsis.usda.gov answers with a fetch error from the review sandbox); https://www.wgcu.org/health/2026-10-17/more-than-1-5-million-pounds-of-meat-poultry-products-recalled-nationwide and https://www.foodsafetynews.com/2026/10/more-than-1-5-million-pounds-of-hot-dogs-bacon-sausage-turkey-breasts-and-more-meat-products-of-various-brands-recalled/ (FSIS wording quoted, read 2026-10-18).
